Name: JP's Artdew Valley Vol XI - Bonsai Trees
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][i][size=6][color=#00ffff][u][center][b]Artdew Valley Vol XI[/b][/center]
[/u][/color][/size][/i]﻿
[color=#ff00ff][size=5][b][i]Because having cute little trees and not having to take care of them (I think they're plastic) is the best![/i][/b][/size][/color]

[size=4][i]This mod consists of 12 volumes so far, this being the eleventh of them. This volume focuses on a wide variety of 30 + 1 bonsai trees in different colors and sizes. I ended up making one more by mistake, but since it was already finished, I had no choice but to leave it in. My mistake.[/i][/size]

[list]
[*][size=4]You can get all the Bonsais at [color=#00ff00]Pierre's store[/color] for the modest price of 1000g each.[/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=4]You will find aprox. 6 bonsais per day, on [color=#00ff00]Mondays, Tuesday, Thursdays, Fridays, and Saturdays[/color]. During that time, you will be able to obtain all 30 + 1 bonsais available in this volume.[/size]
[*][size=4]Despite the large size of some of them, they don't really take up much space![/size]
[*][size=4]They don't have any special interactions, they're just decorations, how sad :([/size]
[/list][size=4]
[/size]
[color=#00ffff][size=5]Not much more to add, I hope you enjoy it![/size][/color]
[i][color=#ffff00][size=6][u]
Translations[/u][/size][/color][/i]
[size=4]You are free to translate the mod; [color=#ff0000]you don't need to ask my permission[/color].
You can publish it yourself on Nexusmods or send it to me to integrate it, it's up to you.
If you like, you can also let me know that your translation has been published, so I know you're out there.[/size]
